# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately through GitHub, since
public issues and pull requests are visible to everyone. Open the Security
tab of this repository and select "Report a vulnerability" (see
[Privately reporting a security vulnerability](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing-information-about-vulnerabilities/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability)
for details).

A useful report says which package (`launcher`) and version (a release or
a commit) is affected and what an attacker can achieve with the
vulnerability. Include the steps to reproduce it and, if you have one, a
proof of concept.

## What happens next

The IW4x projects are maintained by volunteers, who give a security report
priority over their other work. There is no guaranteed response time. Once
we have acknowledged the report, we work on the fix in a private security
advisory and publish the advisory together with the release that contains
the fix. The advisory credits you as the reporter unless you prefer
otherwise.

Please do not disclose the vulnerability publicly until the fix is
released. If you believe the fix is taking too long, say so in the advisory
and we will agree on a date with you.

## Supported versions

Security fixes are made to the latest release of each package and are not
backported to earlier releases.
